table.name: Scalar - Stoich AFR (literal pool)
table.description: Stoichiometric air-fuel ratio (14.7 = gasoline); converts lambda to AFR in the fuel-correction/AFR display. For a different-stoich fuel set this to the new stoich (e.g. 9.76 for E85) and scale 'Scalar - Fuel Load Scale' by 14.7/new stoich. Stock ROMs have no ethanol-indexed stoich table - this fixed scalar is the only stoich constant.

table.name: Scalar - Fuel Load Scale (literal pool)
table.description: Scales engine load into the base injected fuel volume; editing changes open-loop fueling. For a different-stoich fuel scale it by 14.7/new stoich (E85: x1.506), paired with setting 'Scalar - Stoich AFR' to the new stoich.

table.name: Scalar - Load Cell Scale (literal pool)
table.description: Converts air per revolution (g/rev) into the engine-load cell units used by the fuel and ignition maps (1/(engine displacement x air density)).

table.name: Scalar - Air Per Rev Factor (literal pool)
table.description: Seconds-per-minute factor in the air-per-revolution calculation (air flow in g/s to g/rev).

table.name: Scalar - Air Per Rev Clamp (literal pool)
table.description: Upper clamp of the computed air per revolution (g/rev).

table.name: Scalar - Kelvin Offset (literal pool)
table.description: Celsius-to-Kelvin offset used in the intake-air density model.

table.name: Scalar - Kelvin Reference (literal pool)
table.description: Reference temperature in the intake-air density ratio (20 C reference).

table.name: Scalar - Standard Atmosphere kPa (literal pool)
table.description: Standard-atmosphere pressure used to normalize barometric pressure.

table.name: Scalar - Baro ADC Scale kPa (literal pool)
table.description: Barometric-pressure sensor ADC counts to kPa scale.

table.name: Scalar - Fuel Blend Decay (literal pool)
table.description: Per-call decay of the open-loop/closed-loop fueling blend weight.

table.name: Scalar - Diag Engine Load Scale (literal pool)
Scalar - Primary Injector Flow cc/min (literal pool)
table.description: Primary injector flow rating used for the injector pulse-width math; change it when fitting different primary injectors.

table.name: Scalar - Secondary Injector Flow cc/min (literal pool)
table.description: Secondary injector flow rating used for the injector pulse-width math; change it when fitting different secondary injectors.
